title: Zoning text change for Sojourner Truth Mapes, Bronx
summary: This resolution approves a zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area in Bronx Community District 6, tied to a related rezoning of the site. It supports new residential and mixed-use buildings near East 182nd Street and Mapes Avenue, including an eight to sixteen-story building at 2136 Crotona Parkway. The Council held a public hearing on the application on September 9, 2026.
